## Welcome

Welcome to **Introduction to Natural Language Processing**! This course
runs over three days and introduces you to collecting, preprocessing,
and analyzing text data using R.

If you have any inquiries, questions, feedback, or just want a pleasant
chat, please do not hesitate to reach out. I'm always happy to respond
and help as best I can: [mara.weber\@ucl.ac.uk](mailto:mara.weber@ucl.ac.uk).

## What we'll cover

- **Day 1** — Web scraping, working with the Wikipedia API, text
  preprocessing, tokenization, and the document-feature matrix (DFM).
- **Day 2** — Unsupervised learning (topic modeling with LDA) and an
  introduction to supervised learning for text classification.
- **Day 3** — Dictionaries and Naive Bayes classification, word
  embeddings, and an introduction to large language models (LLMs) and
  transformer models.

See the [Schedule](schedule.qmd) for the day-by-day breakdown, or jump
straight to the [Slides](slides/day1.qmd) or [Notes](notes/day1.qmd).
